checks.core_automatic_policy: requires enabled/unlocked/normal tab/one exact account/one current form/mainframe/empty unedited; rejects disabled, locked, private, ambiguous accounts/forms, subframe, different port and ineligible fields
checks.crypto_import: existing AES-GCM/PBKDF2/wrong key/tamper/backup/CSV/Unicode exact bytes/ZIP isolation cases retained
checks.compatibility_roundtrip: not applicable; existing persistence/vault formats and keys unchanged, independent UserDefaults only

implementation.apple: no direct enumeration/read of Apple saved accounts; public focus of real HTML field, iOS owns credential QuickType/key picker and authentication; helper adds missing/off/on autocomplete hints conservatively, preserves explicit new-password/OTP and avoids multiple-password ambiguity
implementation.ui: native bottom suggestions; own account names only unlocked and exact origin; explicit account selection fills; locked local button authenticates then fills unique account or presents choices; gear opens existing manager, x dismisses current document
implementation.automatic: defaultoff, user-enabled, existing authenticated nonexpired session only; one exact account/form, mainframe normal tab, foreground selected trusted HTTPS, blank/unedited; native and JS rechecks, one attempt per form/document, no auto-auth/retries/submit; suppressed with modals/address editing/inactive/dismissed bar
implementation.username_only: requires explicit autocomplete=username; native omits password argument and JS rejects one if present; no password capture for username-only form
implementation.privacy: metadata only field-kind/focus/eligibility booleans, no unsolicited credential values; private explicit own-fill setting retained, auto always excluded in private; Apple focus allowed independently of own private-fill
implementation.preferences: new independent browser vault auto-fill-unlocked and apple-hints keys; no keychain/vault/library/schema/cookie format changes
implementation.bridge: public Objective-C static-code argument command; no optional Swift WebKit overlay/private APIs; update only own user scripts and preserve all other modules/mounted WebViews

limitations: Apple stored-account availability/names cannot be read into the custom bar; Apple button is an entry point, not a claim of a matching saved credential
Apple credential selection/FaceID authentication cannot be bypassed by this setting; no guaranteed standard candidate on every website
CI has no actual Apple password account; verifies actual WK focus and HTML hints, NOT real iCloud entries/QuickType credential content/FaceID or physical keyboard behavior
Debug-only deterministic auth/key/fixed loopback trust bypass compiled out of Release; device Keychain ACL/FaceID acceptance separate
Own no-confirmation mode only works while vault is already unlocked, with one account/form and eligible fields; does not silently unlock or fill private/hidden/cross-origin/edited forms
Unknown/multistep/custom/closed-shadow forms and site-authentication restrictions may still need manual interaction
